data.name: Muhammad
data.gender_notes: Muhammad is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d), 'to praise'. Muhammad is the passive-participle form, literally 'one who is praised'. Its root is ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d). The name of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, the final messenger of Islam (Qur'an 33:40). Muhammad is a Arabic name meaning “Praiseworthy; highly praised”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Muhammad expresses “Praiseworthy; highly praised”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d), 'to praise'. Muhammad is the passive-participle form, literally 'one who is praised'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhammad total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
